en_US: Are you raising different kinds of
Pokémon?
If you only have the same type of
Pokémon, you’ll have a hard time
against types it’s weak to.
Hi, are you the flirty type?
I’m asking you this to make a point.
I teach at the Trainers’ School,
and I’d like to give you a lesson.
But before I do, I’d like you to
have this TM.
You know how Pokémon have genders?
Like, there are males and females?
Well, the move Captivate only works
against the opposite gender.
For example, it only works when used
by a male Pokémon on a female.
The move sharply lowers the target’s
Special Attack, or Sp. Atk for short.
You also probably know this, but a
TM is good for only one use.
Choose the Pokémon wisely if you
do decide to use it.
Floaroma Town
{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}: Hey! {STRVAR_1 3, 1, 0}!
Tell me you got a little tougher!
Me? Do you even need to ask?
Of course I got tougher!
Come on!
I’ll demonstrate it to you!
{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0}: Waah!
What do you mean I lost?!
Well, that’s it!
That’s the last time I’ll ever lose!
I’m going to be the world’s toughest
Trainer, and you know it!
The first thing to do is take on
the Eterna City Pokémon Gym!
I’m gonna toughen up for that,
totally!
Bonjour, Champ.
I was watching you battle just now.
Your skills were très fantastique!
I have been searching for a trainer
like you.
My name is Julien.
Do you have time to hear about a
promotion the SBC is running all over
the region of Sinnoh?
As I say, I am a member of the
Society of Battle Connoisseurs
from the Kalos region.
I have been sent on a mission by
Lady Jacinthe to get the Sinnoh region
as excited as we are for Pokémon
battles and to recruit new members.
To achieve this we are running
promotions all over the region.
There are some trainers who linger
off of the beaten path, in order to
avoid Pokémon battles. L’horreur!
If you seek out and defeat all of these
trainers, I will grant you items that
will help in your upcoming battles.
The first of these is here on Route 204.
If you can defeat all the trainers on
both the north and south portions, I
will give you either a Silk Scarf, or
5 Chilan Berries.
Move quickly, as I can’t stay here for
long. If you continue on past the Valley
Windworks I will have to move on.
Come see me when you’ve defeated them.
Good Luck Champ!
Aucun souci. You must be very busy.
At least come see me if you defeat
every trainer on Route 204.
It will be worth your time.
Au revoir.
Bonjour again.
There are {STRVAR_1 0, 0, 0} Trainers left to
face on Route 204.
Come see me when you’ve defeated them.
Good Luck Champ!
